global_style: Elegant, muted presentation template featuring soft environmental shadow overlays, organic vector accents, and a calm, earthy color palette.

identity_anchors: Simulated dappled light/window shadow overlays across the entire slide canvas
Muted, earthy background shapes (blobs) behind a central elevated white slide canvas
Continuous-line organic vector overlays breaking the boundaries of image boxes
Pill-shaped call-to-action buttons in accent colors

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
